subsystem: DEX virtual dispatch / framework superclass vtable inheritance
observed_discontinuity: Frozen Bubble GameView.<init> invoke-virtual of Thread.start executed GameThread.cleanUp. The receiver slot for Thread.start was cleanUp, so the constructor cleared bitmap fields and never entered java.lang.Thread.start.
required_semantics: Superclass virtual slots keep their index in the subclass.
An override with the same name and shorty replaces the inherited slot.
A new virtual method is appended after the inherited slots.
Framework-created classes and guest DEX classes use that same index.

differences.description: Before the repair, java.lang.Object and java.lang.Thread had vtable_size 0. Thread.start.vtable_idx was the local virtual index 0. GameThread copied no superclass slots, so GameThread.vtable[0] was cleanUp and GameThread.vtable[11] was setRunning.
differences.relevance: GameView.<init> pc 35 invoke-virtual method_idx 252 resolved Thread.start and executed cleanUp. cleanUp nulls mBackground. scaleFrom then threw NullPointerException. java.lang.Thread.start did not run.

earliest_evidenced_divergence: API19 createVtable copies the superclass vtable and sets methodIndex to that slot, or appends a non-override after it. AGR left the framework vtable empty and stored the local virtual index in vtable_idx.

evidence.artifact: android-4.4.4_r2 dalvik vm/oo/Class.cpp createVtable copies clazz->super->vtable, replaces a slot when dvmCompareMethodNamesAndProtos matches, and otherwise appends. Frozen Bubble source robinst/frozen-bubble-android GameView.java at aafe55cb5e3bdce770d87b07564ee5bb7ff11080: GameThread.setRunning assigns mRun, GameView(Context, AttributeSet) calls setRunning(true) then start, and cleanUp is the bitmap recycle path. DEX class_def GameView$GameThread virtual[0] is cleanUp and virtual[11] is setRunning. GameView.<init> VLL pc 30 is invoke-virtual method_idx 247 GameThread.setRunning(Z); pc 35 is invoke-virtual method_idx 252 GameThread.start()V, which resolve walks to java.lang.Thread.start.

Pre-fix class load of /tmp/frozen.dex: Object.vtable_size 0, Thread.vtable_size 0, Thread.start.vtable_idx 0, GameThread.super java.lang.Thread, GameThread.vtable_size 16, GameThread.vtable[0] cleanUp, GameThread.vtable[11] setRunning. Post-fix load: Object.vtable_size 10, Thread.vtable_size 17, Thread.start.vtable_idx 10, cleanUp.vtable_idx 17, setRunning.vtable_idx 28, GameThread.vtable[10] is java.lang.Thread.start. Post-fix probe VDISPATCH: caller GameView.<init> pc 30 op 0x6e method_idx 247 slot GameThread.setRunning; pc 35 op 0x6e method_idx 252 resolved java.lang.Thread.start vtable_idx 10 slot java.lang.Thread.start. cleanUp is not on that path.

Linux vtable inheritance contract: ObjChild invoke of Object.toString and Object.hashCode stays on Object; ObjChild.c returns 5; ObjOver.hashCode returns 324478056; ObjOver.c returns 6; Base.b returns 2; Kid.a returns 1; Kid.b returns 8; Kid.c returns 3; Worker vtable[Thread.start] is java.lang.Thread.start and probeStart returns 11 from Worker.run, not 20 from Worker.cleanUp.

remaining_uncertainty: HLE virtual sets are the methods AGR registered. They are not the full libcore vtables, so absolute slot numbers are not Dalvik's methodIndex values.
The VDISPATCH lines are capped and do not participate in dispatch.
next_action: Do not add a Thread.start or GameThread special case. Thread execution ownership is the separate differential framework-thread-start.json.
host_adaptation: dx_class_build_vtable copies the superclass table, replaces a same-name same-shorty slot, and appends other virtual methods. Interface methods keep vtable_idx -1 and stay on the itable path.
